title: NON-BODY SOLID WASTE COMPACTION AND INHIBITION
description: Objective: To develop a breadboard demonstrating single-step waste inhibition and compaction and characterize cross-linked biodegradable materials compatible for this process.Description: Re-supply and waste management are critical components of crewed space exploration. The current waste management approach exposes the crew to (bio)safety risks during the temporary storage period and is unpractical in longer space missions. Generic waste compaction/inhibition technologies of mixed waste materials in space have been generally studied. However, despite promising results on the volume reduction performance, the physical characteristics of the product obtained allow for limited transformation of re-usable resources. To address this, the activity aims to develop a breadboard demonstrating single-step waste inhibition and compaction and characterize cross-linked biodegradable materials compatible for this process. Lastly, there is a benefit in defining new packaging materials, which are biodegradable in the conditions of identified recycling systems and withstand the proposed compaction and inhibition process. The activity includes the following tasks: - Review single-step waste inhibition/compaction methods compatible with resource recovery (e.g. water) and developed biodegradable materials - Trade-off and selection of integrated waste inhibition and compaction processes and compliant packaging/padding materials. - Design and assembly of a breadboard system for single-step waste inhibition and compaction - Test to validate selected single-step waste inhibition and compaction technological modifications and biodegradability of treated packaging material - Developed cross-linking agents to enhance the barrier properties of biodegradable packaging materials, while maintaining biodegradability and process compatibility - Test to validate biodegradability and intended use of developed packaging. - Define a roadmap for technology maturation for integration into an operational system.Deliverables: Breadboard, Report

title: Pozáruční servis a podpora srážkoměrné radarové sítě CZRAD 2026-31
description: Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je poskytování služeb spočívajících v pozáručním servisu a podpoře srážkoměrné radarové sítě CZRAD (meteorologické radary Brdy-Praha a Skalky a radarové centrum v Praze-Libuši), a to zajištěním prioritní technické podpory, vzdálené diagnostiky problémových stavů, dostupnosti aktualizovaných verzí radarového SW, expresní dodávkou náhradních dílů a pokročilým radarovým školením. Účelem je udržet vysokou dostupnost radarových dat pro uživatele a zkrátit výpadky v případě poruch. Podrobná specifikace předmětu plnění veřejné zakázky je obsažena přímo v této ZD a v přílohách zejména v příloze č. 1 návrhu smlouvy (NEVEŘEJNÁ ČÁST ZD). NEVEŘEJNÁ ČÁST ZADÁVACÍ DOKUMENTACE: Příloha č. 1 návrhu smlouvy – Technická specifikace předmětu plnění Výše uvedená příloha zadávací dokumentace bude dle § 36 odst. 8 ZZVZ ve spojení s § 96 odst. 2 ZZVZ předána dodavateli na základě jeho žádosti podané nejlépe prostřednictvím elektronického nástroje NEN (dále jen „NEN“) nebo též datové schránky nebo e-mailem a to do 3 pracovních dnů od doručení žádosti dodavatele o její poskytnutí. Žádost musí být podána v elektronické formě. title: FLAT PANEL MASS-MARKET KA-BAND USER TERMINAL EXPRO PLUS
description: Objective: Develop a low-cost flat panel antenna in Ka-band for the SATCOM consumer marketDescription: Ka-band Flat panel Antennasdeveloped for SATCOM user terminals are typically based on very challenging performance requirements. This leads to high costs, effectively preventing such terminals to enter the consumer market. While significant advancements in satcom terminal technologiesparticularly flat panel antennas with single aperture for transmit and receivehave been made outside Europe, the availability of such technologies in Europe remains limited. The activity focuses on the development of a low-cost flat panel antenna in Ka-band for the SATCOM consumer market. The antenna shall be compliant with good enough performance requirements to provide reliable and sufficient connectivity to NGSO satellites. In particular, services such as (but not limited to) browsing, email, video calls and low data rate streaming (e.g. audio streaming) have to be guaranteed. The minimum data rate for these services shall be defined and used as a starting point to flow down the antenna requirements. Once the minimum requirements are derived, the activity shall focus on simplification and cost reduction with respect to currently available solutions. The investigation on cost reduction shall also include a projection of the consumer price assuming the terminal will be mass produced in the future. This activity encompasses the following tasks:- Consolidation of the requirements, - Trade-off analysis among several solutions and identification of the most promising antennaconfiguration, - Design and detailed analysis, - Manufacture and testing of a representative simplified antenna Breadboard.
